1. (Currently amended) A composition comprising an active ingredient which is a compound of formula I:

[formula structure]

wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9 and R10 are independently hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkoxy, or other substituents as defined in the specification, and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, __for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, __wherein said composition is formulated for therapeutic treatment of skin conditions__.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0,00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight, __and wherein the composition is specifically formulated for treating acne vulgaris__.

5. (Previously presented) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a __therapeutic__ composition __for treating skin diseases associated with defective keratinisation__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the __treatment__ of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, __specifically__ for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, __specifically__ ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component, and __specifically__ all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for __therapeutic treatment in__ hair care and/or hair follicle development.

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __therapeutic__ care, __treatment__ or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __in patients suffering from skin diseases associated with defective keratinisation__.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for __therapeutic__ skin lightening and/or skin whitening __in the treatment of pigmentation disorders__.

13. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment of__ skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin __associated with skin diseases__.

14. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment of__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair __associated with defective keratinisation__, __specifically__ for __treatment of__ dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the __treatment__ or prevention of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin __in patients with skin diseases__.
